notablePrerequisites: Tetravus has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tetravus' first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Tetravus' second ability, choosing not to exile any tokens.
Resolve Tetravus' first ability, causing you to remove five +1/+1 counters from Tetravus to create five 1/1 Tetravite creature tokens.
The Tetravites enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade five times, putting five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
